public_body: Swansea Water District Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing a noticed topic in executive session when the notice listed it only for open session. No further remedy was ordered because the minutes were already released.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board met in executive session on June 4 although the meeting notice did not list an executive session.
Whether the topic discussed in executive session (district employee compensation and benefits) fell within a proper executive session purpose was raised but not decided.
allegations.key_passage: We do not address herein whether the topic that was listed on the meeting notice fell within a proper statutory purpose for executive session.
